findings.F1: In agitated markets only falls are reversed in proportion to their size: on agitated down days the next-day excess return falls by 0.0093 per unit of standardised fall (t -2.62, 1439 cases, 537 days). On agitated up days the slope is +0.0026 (t 1.24, 1505 cases). On calm down days it is -0.0022 (t -0.80, 1978 cases). Where the close sits in the day's range adds nothing (t -0.65 once the net change is in).
findings.F2: On agitated down days, the day's relative volume carries the grading. The product of the standardised fall and the log of the day's volume against its 20-day average has a slope of -0.0079 (t -5.71, 1439 cases, 537 days). Fitted together, the product keeps t -2.92 and the fall alone drops to t -0.65, while relative volume alone adds nothing (t 0.10).
findings.F3: The volume-weighted grading of F2 points the same way on every coin, with t from -2.17 (XMR) to -8.89 (ETH), and in 2018, 2019 and 2020 (t -2.19, -2.27, -5.52). It fades in 2021 (t -0.20, 474 cases).
findings.F4: The volume-weighted grading lives only in agitated falls. The same product has a t of -0.09 on calm down days (1978 cases), 0.30 on agitated up days and -0.63 on calm up days.
findings.F5: The rebound is mostly spent after one day. The slope on the second day after an agitated fall is +0.0021 (t 0.67). The third day shows a weaker leftover of -0.0038 (t -1.96), which cannot be told from chance across the many angles looked at.
findings.F6: Agitated up days are followed by a next-day excess return below the drift that does not grow with the rise (intercept -0.0071, t -2.31; slope +0.0026, t 1.24). Agitated rise deciles 5 to 9 have next-day means of -0.0067, -0.0072, -0.0032, -0.0013 and -0.0024. There is no graded fade of rises to build on.
findings.F7: The book's results come from tail days. On its best 5 % of active days the coin moved +11.1 % after a previous day of -10.8 %. On its worst 5 % the coin moved -10.2 % after a previous day of -7.1 %. Across all active days the mean is +0.16 %, against a coin move of -1.19 %.
findings.F8: Weekday splits of agitated falls look uneven: next-day excess means have t 3.48 on Tuesday, 3.79 on Sunday, -0.90 on Monday, and a fall slope t -8.12 on Thursday against roughly 0 on other days. With seven groups each looked at several ways, and no reason behind them, they are not counted as findings for ideas.

ideas.idea: In an agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day fall multiplied by how heavy that day's volume was against its average daily volume of the last 20 days, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A trader buying agitated-market falls should size up on falls that came on unusually heavy volume and size down on falls on thin volume, since the forced selling that gets paid back shows in the volume.
ideas.name: heavy-volume agitated fall rebound
